observations: Photo 0 shows a black headlamp with a bright white light beam projecting downward, placed on a beige shaggy carpet. The headlamp has a rectangular battery pack with a blue LED indicator and a pink label with text. The strap has 'LED LIGHT' printed on it.

Photo 1 shows the same headlamp from a side angle, with the light beam visible. The battery pack has a red label with 'LED' and 'RECHARGEABLE' written on it. The lens is circular with a visible LED chip inside.

Photo 2 shows the headlamp from a top-down angle, with the strap and battery pack clearly visible. The strap has 'LED LIGHT' printed repeatedly. The battery pack has a red label with 'LED' and 'RECHARGEABLE' written on it.
All photos show the headlamp on a textured carpet, with no visible damage to the casing or strap.
The light beam in photo 0 is very bright, suggesting the LED is functional.
No model number or brand name is visible on any part of the headlamp in any photo.

claims.claim: This is a 5000mAh battery powered rechargeable super bright light worn on the head for work or...
claims.evidence: The battery pack has a red label with 'LED' and 'RECHARGEABLE' visible in photo 1 and photo 2, but no capacity (mAh) is visible. The brightness is shown in photo 0, but 'super bright' is subjective and not verifiable remotely.

risks.risk: The battery capacity is not stated and may be less than 5000mAh.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the battery pack showing the capacity label, or a video showing the battery being charged and discharged.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a lower-capacity headlamp, possibly 2000-3000mAh

risks.risk: The headlamp may not be fully functional (e.g., no charging, no light output, or damaged internal components).
risks.proof: A video showing the headlamp being charged and turned on, with the light beam being adjusted and tested in different modes.

risks.risk: The strap may be loose or damaged, affecting comfort and safety.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the strap showing its material, stitching, and attachment points.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a potentially loose or damaged strap

proof_requests: Close-up of the rating plate on the battery showing the model and capacity.
A video showing the headlamp being charged and turned on, with the light beam being adjusted and tested in different modes.
A close-up photo of the battery pack showing the capacity label.
A close-up photo of the strap showing its material, stitching, and attachment points.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
